svg.text: you can smell it from the corner
on Fridays you can’t see the bricks
from here it’s just roofs and the tree

08:07, the warm step — the first time the town gives you something without being asked. 08:20, the bench — the first time you stop for no reason, which is the moment a place becomes yours. 17:48, the gate — the bin is in, the paper is gone, the light is on: the town kept living while you wandered.

the market shelter (arrives too complete, nothing worn); the pub barrels (set-dressed, not left); the lane’s rails (too regular — hands would have bent one). Each needs the sim’s handwriting, not mine.
WHERE IT DISAPPEARS INTO EVERYDAY LIFE
the crossing · the washing · the worn grass · the chalk · the board’s papers · the empty Tuesday square
would someone walk it when they don’t have to?
